notes.title: Builders of China - Devlog #17 - "Poor and rich, water and ground"
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

Let's learn some more about the buildings that you will build in our game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/a32ab9ac5458c36ad041082ee225128f4166c057.jpg

We're going to start, however, with our best wishes for everyone celebrating Lunar New Year! It's the year of the Tiger and as per our tradition we've prepared another postcard for the occasion - you can enlarge it by clicking with your right mouse button on it and opening it fully on another window/tab. We hope that you like the art as our artists made sure to make the tiger both admirable and solemn! We simply think it's amazing and we hope that you will have a splendid time celebrating Lunar New Year! 

Now, let's talk about buildings! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/a35defb83562ce849eb53c3dd0f122fa30b2593f.png

We're working on few specific systems regarding most of the housing buildings - spaces where our citizens will be able to live and go about their business. Those two systems are presented on the screenshot above in a grid. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/557bbbe9b491928432a8b5616466e721afa76003.png

First of the systems is designed to showcase differences between houses depending on the type of terrain you're building on. Foundation of our building will look different based on the type of ground that you're trying to create the building on. That means that buildings can look a little bit different if your construct them on mountains area than the same buildings placed on water. That means that you will be able to construct some of the buildings in very different environments showcasing the sould and heart of the people living in the area - no matter what kind of difficulties they face on, they always can find a proper solution! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/f74f44bd3aa7f6b8ecd7b08dbf9df61ca37b0e3e.png

The buildings will also be different from each other depending on the wealth of their citizens. Currently we're working on 3 different levels showcasing various states of wealth. The bigger wealth your city and citizens own, the better the buildings will look like - subsequently the poorer you are the more it will show. Buildings come in three varieties - poor looking wooden shacks, regular tidy houses and lavish beautiful constructions. Depending on your actions the citizens will either live in comfort... or in shame. 

Thank you for checking in with us - make sure to wishlist the game and see you in the next devlog!

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Let's enter the Happy New Year of 2022!

Let's welcome the New Year of 2022 with smiles on our faces!

The New Year is just starting - a year that is surely going to be full of great time and unforgettable moments! 

How are your New Year creations and outfits? We know that in contemporary world it is still difficult to go out and enjoy yourself but we hope that wherever you are you're safe and you're enjoying the New Year festivities with class and zazz! We at Live Motion Games know that each year presents us all with great opportunities and chances - the only important thing is to remember that we should all pursue those chances and do our best to transform them into real events and achievements! We would like to wish you all fulfillment, happiness and personal satisfaction in all your endavours and we hope that development of Builders of China will add to the great positive moments of the New Year! 

Have a great New Year everyone!

notes.title: Builders of China - Devlog #16 - "People, people, people..." #2
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

We're back with some awesome concept arts showcasing your future subjects!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/51967adefd6a0c5327e0cf5c8867868ac50ec367.png

In the previous devlogs we've showcased some of the designs for the people from higher spheres that you will surely have the chance to meet while playing Builders of China. You will not, however, be surrounded only by people coming from the high class and other aristocrats. Normal people, villagers and citizens are the soul of the nation and without them you will amount to nothing. Winning their acceptance and trust will be the key to creating a great Empire!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/70755eb0b99e36a93c734f01e8acfcf7eb30339a.png

People are different - that's something we all know from the real life and we're sure to include different variations of NPCs in the game. Some of them might be more scrawnier looking while other perhaps like to eat a bit more than the others. All of them are instrumental in the process of construction of your Empire. As you can see we're aiming for specific design style and we hope you'll like the direction in which we're going. As you might imagine what you will see in the game will be based on artworks just like those we're presenting above. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/efee1842fdb62c84f0c82a358c75401f4a5c258b.png

We also hope to properly emulate the spirit and atmosphere of the times while accentuating our stylistic choices. Fun looking characters invoking happiness just by looking at them running around the village will be clothed appropriately and will live in specific buildings that will also thematically fit together and create a coherent entirety. We'll be happy to present you with the effects of our labour and we'd appreciate all your comments in that regard!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/6f73d183d5fc6e427c895ee7d0646676df7f5d1c.png

Thank you for checking in with us - make sure to wishlist the game and see you in the next devlog!

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Builders of China - Devlog #15 - "Hustle of a daily life"
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

Life in the Empire can be quite colourful!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/e40daff20cd86c26911de9843079d80f92723a6e.png

Last time we had fun sharing some screenshots from the game with you - keep in mind that those were the still work-in-progress kind of designs - and this month we would love to showcase some of the concept arts that we are working on! Those images you see on your screen right now will help us set the right tone and create the appropriate atmosphere for the game - we base our further decisions on the creation of similar artworks that is why they are extremely important for us and we often spend more than few days on revisions and improvements. 

The images look pretty - and they really are - but they're not just for admiring purposes but also for making sure that we have it all under control and we all know in which artistic direction we are heading. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/d19851818c15534c59df588c236184eb99c3cdc6.png

On those two screenshots you can see different places. The first one showcases the peasant district in a city. As you might imagine it's full of bustle and colours giving it the vibe of being alive and energetic. That is correct for the place and as we imagine it - who knows how many different discussions and chats have happened here? 

The second artwork showcases fishing district - while still being architecturally speaking busy it is quite more peaceful and deliberate in its reception. The colour of the water, not fighting for the attention but simply signalizing the natural flow of the waters symbolizes the harmony and order. As fisherman gather here to start their day and commence their work they will definitely enjoy the area in which their endeavours take place...


Thank you for checking in with us - make sure to wishlist the game and see you in the next devlog!

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Builders of China - Devlog #14 - "Beginning of the city"
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

Our work on the game gains momentum and we'd love to share with you some early images from the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/dca697a4d6a675052e8592ddf610741303b302b3.png

The village at night looks rather lovely - the colourful lanterns fill the space with kind warmth, ready for villagers to come and enjoy their evening while eating a tasty supper, regaining the vitality and vigour necessary for the next day. It is only the beginning of their adventure, the Empire is always calling for more and they know that only with their gathered forces will they be able to not only construct but maintain a fascinating ancient city. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/2ff25de4257990081aeed2b1e25046047c69d8f9.png

They have the luck to live in a beautiful area - with a mesmerizing river flowing to their side and picturesque trees in full bloom they know that life is good under the rule of the current Emperor. Surely, the Mandate of Heaven is safe in his hands as they've been enjoying the hospitality of nature and can focus on other endeavours - architecture, art or poetry. Or they can simply sit at the riverside and enjoy the view! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/6ca26323b6db8e4b655db6edb3af4e3435f67381.png

Of course there are also their duties waiting to be fulfilled, their workplaces ready to receive and welcome them with the sense of familiarity. So many places will be full of everyday's noise and clamour so normal for another fantastic day in the Empire... 

Do keep in mind that our work is on-going - the buildings might receive different shape and the final look of the game might different from what we're presenting you at the moment. Nonetheless, we're doing our best to create an amazing game for you!

Make sure to wishlist the game! See you in the next devlog!

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

notes.title: Builders of China - Devlog #12 - "People, people, people..."
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

Let's focus on people - those that will help you, work for you but also demand from you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/4784ed872a56ca1394d0af04389de109623b1daa.png

No Empire can exist without people. No matter if we're talking about workers, officials, aristocracy - people are the most important part of every country. In this particular devlog we'll be happy to show you some of the faces that you will most definitely see in the game. Take a look at those that will become a part of your journey in Builders of China. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/81a126747e9df17fcf3d6c3320b5c6b4ed96a7f9.png

Of course, we cannot start any other way but with Emperor. A central figure of the empire, a person that is the most important and that one can fear and respect at the same time. It will be him that will assign different tasks to you. It will also be him that will either reward or punish you depending on the results of your endavours. Generally speaking - his words do carry a certain power and authority that shouldn't be underestimated. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/4ab84192b79eae167f6e5b40a072bcafeba2d4aa.png

An older and kinder official will be there to help you in your quests. He might have a great advice for you making it easier to progress or bring you some comfort in the more difficult moments. You're not alone, you see, there is always someone who will try to bring you up and help! And in this case an experienced helper is worth his weight in gold! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/531903296d0b26d0479f4a7c9e4b8e67a8c7b58e.png

Of course there is much more people in the Empire and you might also see different aristocrats and officials during your playthrough. Those might simply wander the areas of your cities minding their own business but you should always heed their voices and check whether they are living comfortably or perhaps are not satisfied with how things are going. 

Many people in the Empire and only one you - we're however sure that you will succeed!

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390760/Builders_of_China/

notes.title: Builders of China - Devlog #11 - "Places and missions!"
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

There will be many places that you will visit in Builder of China - let's check some of them now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/be92320d212968cdbbeaf058ec4b621a0be91af3.png

Our game will take you to different places where you'll have to face varied challenges. Sometimes it will be a bit easier, other times you'll be scratching your head thinking how you can succeed in difficult and sometimes changing conditions. One of such places that we can give you a glimpse of (illustration above) is Kuizhou. 

Kuizhou was of particular importence during Tang Dynasty in China partly because of its close proximity to Yangzi River but also - culturally speaking - because the exiled poets often found themselves here writing among beautiful scenery about their hardships and difficulties. Kuizhou was also a place where officials had to come when Emperor decided to banish them for different mishaps.

Kuizhou is but one example of the places you're going to visit. Below you can see an illustration for other village you'll be able to take into your care and make sure it prospers. While playing through Builders of China you will have to face several different missions and challenges and only completing them will award you the final victory. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/b5857e7d0a9cd3571b0e2670ddd0a8c10ca3ec01.png

For example - you might have to develop agriculture in a terrain that is very difficult to manage, where every single piece of flat field is worth its weight in gold. Only by careful planning will you be able to succeed! Otherwise, in a different location, you might have to establish trade between your establishment and another city... 

Either of those tasks will test and challenge you and we hope that they will bring a lot of fun and joy to you! 

Is there any specific location that you feel we should definitely include? Let us know in the comments!

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Builders of China - Devlog #9 - "Animals in the town!"
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

Humanity was always intrinsically connected with animals and building an Empire will also mean dealing with the fauna!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/d525fa217172c5c03e943d3818819f7d7c3d954f.png

There is so many ways that animals can be helpful when trying to establish your own empire. As you start with smaller villages and enclaves they very often fulfill many important roles for the whole community. For many workers they can be an invaluable asset but for almost all they are somewhat a part of the overall scenery. Afterall it's hard to imagine a village without the occasional sound made by one of the animals kept around. Be it donkey's hee-haw or...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/1e3d273b694531c67663ce1411f8780b9a5ffadd.png

...goats "horsing" around. Or should we say "goating" around? You can simply look at the picture to see that they can indeed play around with the force of many party-goers at once (can you spot the little troublemaker?). 

Either way - in Builders of China animals will be a valuable asset. After all you have got to feed many people in your cities and towns and keeping livestock will definitely make it easier for people living in your empire. Why forage when you can take care of your beloved piggies?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/46107b41236e7dd6a25005edb30c91939b158f97.png

Of course you will be also able to see many other animals in the game - as they can be extremely useful for the tasks of transportation and helping out merchants or explorers. Many of them will find their way in the game and will be important for the discovery of the graphically recreated world of the Empire of China that you will be building. 

With their help, of course. 

Thanks for checking in - stay tuned for future devlogs and make sure to wishlist the game to stay updated!

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Happy Easter from Builders of China Team!
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

As we approach Easter we would like to wish you all a great, happy and warm time to relax - let this weekend be a great one!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/5ca87fe16d87085767c0a13f8159cfd60157e1bc.png

While this particular holiday is not that popular in China we still would like to take this chance to wish you all a great weekend. We hope you will find some time to relax, recharge your batteris and simply rest! In these days especially it's important to find those little moments of happiness and celebrate them properly and that is why we sincerely hope you will be able to do just so! 

Easter is inherently connected with Easter Eggs. What you can see on the image above is the Century Egg - sometimes also called as hundred-years eggs, millenium eggs or simply black eggs. It's a Chinese egg-based dish that is made by preserving the egg in a mixture of specially prepared ingredients including clay, ash, salt, rice hulls and quicklime. Preparation of this type of egg can take even up to several months depending on the process used. It might be a very interesting addition to our typical Easter Eggs! 

Happy Easter!

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

notes.title: Open beta testing is coming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As you might know Live Motion Games hosts a variety of interesting projects that we are proud to work on.

We are happy to say that day by day we make progress on each of them getting closer and closer to the release date of each of the particular games we work on. Our teams are busy as bees, as they say, but the enthusiasm within them is steadily growing - easily translating into creation of many great features that you will be able to test soon. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36301902/061f2d8fa45988cd2b486e4570022c36b4b66b0d.png

And speaking of testing - some of our projects still are accepting the sign-ups for the playtests that will happen directly on Steam. Below you'll find the list of games that are included in the play-tests project that will happen in future. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36301902/3e438a16e1826f5440e32ef4860fad71249e8ee6.jpg

Builder Simulator - if you've ever dreamed about creating your very own house, exactly as you would like it to be then dream no more - Builder Simulator will allow you to do just that. It's a game dedicated to each of you who find joy in creation and execution of your own ideas. After all in the game you'll be able to go through every step of the construction process. 


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36301902/ab561cf24f5653753231f04b3121cd8d59e556e0.jpg

Chernobyl Liquidators Simulator - is a project where we tackle the topic of the catastrophe that happened in Chernobyl in April, 1986. We are approaching the topic seriously and realistically - no monsters in game but instead you will have to work hard in order to contain the radiation, complete your tasks as Liquidator and work for the sake of others.


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36301902/86c13bd835e81ab21f5354a82195d8b37d27f0f0.jpg

Builders of China - our take on the management type of game where you will be responsible for the well-being and development of different Chinese settlements. Your decision will influence establishing trading outposts, growth of the population and research in new technologies. Will you hold to the Mandate of Heavens? 


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36301902/a83b2adcaa59a8d6c279ccd951f96658e3149680.jpg

Supermarket Manager - if you ever wanted to manage your own Supermarket - here is a chance for you. You'll be tasked with many duties including hiring your own employees, equipping the market or developing your store. Create the market you can! 


Currently we are happy to say that playtests for Chernobyl Liquidators Simulator will happen soon and shortly after them tests for Builder Simulator will follow. You might then expect our other games listed above to follow the suit in foreseeable future. 

We invite you all to join the playtests - it's a great opportunity to check the games before release and influence the way they are developed. We'll be looking into your feedback as much as possible when deciding on further functions and features. We'll also make sure to eliminate all bugs your reports will bring to light.

Thank you for your continuous support. We are blessed to have such a great community and we hope to bring you the best games! 

Kind regards,
Live Motion Games

notes.title: Let's celebrate Chinese New Year!
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

As you might now - today we're celebrating New Lunar Year!

We hope that for everyone this new lunar year will be full of great moments, spectacular experiences and meaningful opportunities. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/8239be0cc1d75a75050a888563d2c850d77cb8ce.png

Lunar New Year is a festival that celebrates the beginning of a new year on the traditional Chinese calendar. It is not uncommon to hear it being called Spring Festival! 

As you might already new there is always a particular animal assigned to each year and this year will be the Year of the Ox! 

This particular holiday is one of the most important holidays in China but it is also celebrated worldwide in regions with a significant presence of Chinese population. Traditionally the festival was a time to honour deities as we as ancestors however the particular customs in China differ depending on the area of the country. However some of the things that are most widely popular are:

1). Clean your house with your whole family - sweep away bad and invite good fortune
2). Decorate windows and doors with red paper-cuts and couplets. 
3). It's popular to have fun with firecrackers
4). Giving money in red envelopes is a traditional thing to do on that holiday

Remember - red items are considered lucky - so make sure to have something red close to you on this day! 

Have fun today and have a great New Lunar Year celebrations!

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Builders of China - Devlog #6 - "Place to live - a simple and lovely hut!"
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

Last time we talked briefly about villagers hair and you provided us with a lot of feedback regarding your favourites. This time we'd love to see your opinions about... houses!

Beta test sign-ups are still on-going and we invite you all to send your application in order to have a chance to play the game and check it for yourself a little bit earlier!

There simply cannot be a builder without a building they themselves could call their home. Everyone of us needs to take a breather in a safe haven provided by our own 4 walls and that is a truth that has been known through ages. Our lovely subjects, working for the glory of the Empire, also need to rest and sleep somewhere and we had the lovely opportunity to design their houses and farmlands. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/68335f5c2c94b245d24245df5f4469c0478b5d22.png

We were quite dedicated to make sure that even a small detail would look appropriately as we discussed the house design with our specialists in the particular field. On the picture you can see the designs and how they evolved through time. Even something that might seem trivial as grass placement or the positioning of flowers near the hut is not a thing we can omit - a heated (yet civilized!) discussions took place to make sure that we can find the best spot for each of the features and to make sure that the overall image of the farm stays creatively diverse and atmospheric. 

And to make it more clear for you - looking at the picture:

The linearts presents the early concepts for the huts and placements of features around them. That is an important stage as we need to at least limit the number of concepts before going into another step. 

Then some more detailed work was done to ensure that we can find just the right look for our building. Afterall we would love for its dwellers to feel as happy as they can! 

Then you can see the final creation for thist particular concept art - image of the hut from its front and back. 

We think it looks lovely but more importantly - what do you think about this little glimpse into the game? 


Hope the New Year is treating you well! Stay tuned for more soon!

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

notes.title: Builders of China - Devlog #5 - "Hair of a builder"
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

Game development is inseparably linked with art creation and concepting! This time we would love to explore the characters that will live in the world of the game we’re creating and we invite you to join us!

Builders of China is about us supervising the grand process of building a great empire but at the same time it’s about people (builders!) walking, working and living in the places that we have prepared for them. And all of those people need their own faces, their own hairstyles, clothes, boots and so on! During the game development we have explored many different ideas and consulted our specialists from the fields of Chinese culture in order to make sure that we have a wide selection of “looks” available for our builders. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/0847e00ef84cd675b815fa28c36dd5c2581d4076.png

As you can see we have prepared several different variations of the hairstyles for our female villagers. Do remember that when you create concept art you explore a variety of possibilities - we can’t say that all of them you will see in the game itself. It’s also difficult for us to choose a clear favourite among those options but we feel like you might be able to tell us more about those that you liked the best! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/d2a6da6d6d023ca6d9c7176f06b6e71ec9371af0.png

Of course we’re not forgetting about male builders that you will be able to spot in the game. In this case we’ve tried exploring not only hairstyle but also beards and facial hair, checking what would look the best on our brave villagers. As you might already know we’re still working on the visual aspects of our game and our artists are busy preparing many different variations of which most likely a small percentage will find the way into a final game. Us sharing these concept arts with you is a small glimpse into incredibly potent word of art creation for game development and we would like to also this moment in order to appreciate all artists involved in the projects. 

Now that you had the chance to see them - which are your favourite concepts?

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

notes.title: Builders of China - Devlog #4 - "Time and Dynasty"
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

Let us talk a little bit about the time period that we will be focusing in the game.

Time goes by very quickly when you're working on a great project and you know that there are a lot of great fans waiting for your game. And it has been quite busy for us these days because every day is a great adventure and another step on the road leading us to fully become Builders of China.

Recently some of you have expressed an interest in learning about the time period that we'll be focusing on in the game. We strongly believe that there are many fascinating stories and moments that are waiting to be re-discovered by all of us (and (and we definitely know that everyone has their own favourite period of history!) but for the moment our main focus falls upon the Tang Dynasty - truly golden time in the history of China. It was then when Chang'an, the Perpetual Peace, was the biggest city in the whole world! In this period new building techniques were discovered and many, many projects started to appear enrichening the culture of the whole nation... 

Hopefully under our wings we too will be able to reach that level or even elevate the nation to a higher position! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/6b3dfc9307e85c0e0d95b262c860583139739c36.gif

What you see above is just a small part of what we've been working on these days. As you might see we're trying to make sure that game is graphically stunning in all of its elements and not without a certain charm that makes it unresistible to fans of Chinese history and culture (and keep in mind that gifs always reduce the quality of the video). We'll be happy to share more with you very soon but for now let us leave you with this little sneak peek into our inner workings. 

And what is your favourite period of time in the history of China? Let us know in the comments!

Best regards,
Builders of China Team

notes.title: Builders of China - Devlog #1 - "Q&A"
notes.content:
Hello Builder,

Nice to meet you! 

This is our very first devlog from Builders of China. 🥳 🎊

With this entry, we would like to introduce ourselves and answers the most important questions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/9bbc85b31a4074c0cd247b19cb5fe9459e594cc9.png

 Who we are?

Simply said, players for players company.

We are an experienced team of polish game developers, comprised of all major specialties such as game and level design, programming, art, animation, or UI design. Most of our members have extensive game dev background and multiple released projects under our belts.

We would like to provide you with a possible best game. That's why your ideas, suggestions, and active participation is one of the most important factors in our opinion. 

⬇ Add game to wishlist to stay in touch with us ⬇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/f3970aa12831f8120a099837330625c35e257809.gif


 What you can expect from us?


From time to time we will be delivering fresh news about progress in game production.

We invite you to join our discord server where you will be able to:


 talk to us (devs) and other fans of this game;
 present your ideas and suggestions for the game;
 get to know the plans for the game for the coming weeks;
 take part in giveaways

Our Discord: https://discord.gg/Du6B6s9


 What's the Builder of China?

It is a relaxing city builder game simulating economy and population of ancient China. It's setting and story is based on real world events in Chinese history.

In-game you will be able to:

 manage the economy of various settlements
 establish bustling cities
 govern your population
 trade with your neighbors
 research new technologies
 spread your culture and knowledge

and many, many more.


✅ To be up to date with the latest updates. Visit our social media profiles: 

LMG! on Facebook
LMG! on Twitter
LMG! on DISCORD

Do you have any questions? Feel most welcomed to ask about anything.
